source: Production Upstash Redis resilience ranking snapshot
snapshotNote: Post-P1-1 full-universe capture: pillar scores applied domain design weights inside pillar aggregation on 2026-08-29.
detailSource: Production Upstash Redis per-country resilience score snapshots

methodology.overallScoreFormula: penalizedPillarScore(pillars): sum(pillar.score * pillar.weight) multiplied by (1 - 0.5 * (1 - min_pillar / 100)). Pillar weights: structural-readiness=0.40, live-shock-exposure=0.35, recovery-capacity=0.25.
notes: Current production formula after the RESILIENCE_PILLAR_COMBINE_ENABLED activation tracked in issue #3954.
Every score is lower than or equal to the equivalent weighted pillar mean because the min-pillar penalty factor is <= 1.
The formula is intentionally non-compensatory: one weak pillar limits the overall score instead of being fully washed out by strong domains.
methodology.coverageLabel: Mean dimension coverage (avg of the 21 per-dimension coverage values). Labelled 'Dimension coverage' in publications to avoid the ambiguity of 'Data coverage'.
